chapterDescription: Soap, organic surface-active agents; washing, lubricating, polishing or scouring preparations; artificial or prepared waxes, candles and similar articles, modelling pastes, dental waxes and dental preparations with a basis of plaster
sourceLabel: UN Comtrade public API (preview), United States imports, annual, HS
